model.units: scaled units: one unit is 1 uM in the engine's world; time in s (BITSEY's unit)
equations: du/dt = g_u H(z; K_u, n_u, lambda_u) - k_u u + (junction terms, u only)
dm/dt = g_m H(z; K_m, n_m, lambda_m) - k_m m
dz/dt = g_z m sum_{i=0..6} C(6, i) l_i X^i / (1 + X)^6 - k_z z, X = u / x0
junction (a, b): its flux G (u_a - u_b) leaves a and enters b; G / V = D A_cell / (L_GJ V_cell) = 3 D / (r L_GJ)
model.constants_source: BITSEY's cancer_GJ_sims/GRN_miRNA.py at b2cb370 (numbers only, D208), scaled as it scales them, with Snail = 72 folded into g_u = 6 (1 + 0.4)/2 and g_m = (5/12)(1 + 10)/2; ITERATE = False, so the binding uses total miR200

seeds.note: BITSEY seeds 0 where these are 1e-6 (the engine needs positive amounts)

stages.rule: stage 1: one tumor cell and one healthy cell, no junctions, 500 s from the seeds, once; every tumor cell of stage 2 starts at stage 1's tumor end state, every healthy cell at its healthy one; stage 2 runs 20,000 s coupled, its clock from 0

criterion.cell: u > m + 2 at the end of stage 2, in every cell
criterion.rows: for every row, max m - min m <= 2; a row is the cells with one z (the last lattice index)
criterion.source: BITSEY's GRN_miRNA.py healthy_snapped_rows (line 519), on the whole field

line.lattice: 1 x 1 x 25: cells c0..c24 along z
line.rows: each cell is its own row, so the spread condition is empty

field.lattice: 1 x 25 x 25: cell c{y}_{z}, y and z in 0..24
field.tumor: y < 6 and z < 6 (a 6 x 6 block at the corner)
field.junctions: one per pair one lattice step apart (c{y}_{z} - c{y}_{z+1} and c{y}_{z} - c{y+1}_{z}), 1,200 in all; no diagonals

search.ends: D = 0 must not normalize and D = 1e-13 must; both are run
search.stop: hi <= (1 + 0.001) lo, hi the smallest normalizing D and lo the largest below it that does not; reported x2 = hi
search.placement: free: any sequence of points that narrows the bracket to the stopping rule, every point integrated from stage 1's end state over the full 20,000 s
search.tighter: the final bracket's two ends again at a ten-fold tighter integration tolerance; both must keep their outcomes

keys.model: {constants: {every key of model.constants, each value as read}, seeds: {tumor: {u, m, z}, healthy: {u, m, z}} as read from model.seeds}
keys.stage1: {tumor: {u, m, z}, healthy: {u, m, z}} after 500 s uncoupled
keys.geometries: {line, field}: {bracket: [lo, hi], points: [{d, normalized, epithelial_cells, min_margin, max_row_spread}], tighter: {factor, lo_normalized, hi_normalized}, method}; a geometry the references did not compute is absent and is then not assessable

conditions: lo not normalized and hi normalized, in points and again at the tighter tolerance
points monotone in d, with 0 not normalized and 1e-13 normalized
